evidence.name: Screen field: Purchase button shadow
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Purchase button shadow" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Purchase button shadow
sections.description: Optionally adds a soft shadow beneath the button so it lifts off the screen and pulls the eye toward your call-to-action. You can tune the softness (blur), size (spread), strength (opacity), and direction (offset). A subtle shadow usually works best; leave it off for a flat design.
